title: Trapped Inside The Endless Halls
hook: I got trapped INSIDE a Pulsebox game... the only way out is the kid who made it

messages.label: FLOOR 13 · FUSES 0/3
messages.text: 3:07 AM. Jay clicked play on The Endless Halls. The screen flashed yellow... and he wasn't in his room anymore.
i'm INSIDE your game
jay it's 3am. what are you talking about
...the endless halls??
don't panic. i made this game. i can get you out
find *3 fuses*. power the EXIT stairwell. reach the lobby before sunrise
and if i don't make it by sunrise?
you don't want to know

messages.label: FLOOR 13 · FUSES 0/3
messages.text: The first fuse was at the end of the hall. So was something else... crawling on the ceiling. With no eyes.
something with no eyes is on the ceiling
the crawler. it's blind. it hunts by *sound*
walk slow. don't run. and DON'T text back
4 minutes later
got it. fuse 1

messages.label: FLOOR 13 · FUSES 1/3
messages.text: Fuse two was guarded by something pale. Every time Jay blinked... it was closer.
it MOVES when i blink
the watcher. never take your eyes off it
fuse 2. but my flashlight is at *3%*

messages.label: FLOOR 13 · FUSES 2/3
messages.text: Then his flashlight died. And in the dark... something smiled.
milo it's SMILING at me
the grin. it hides from *light*
your phone. turn the brightness ALL the way up
Brightness 100%
it's gone. fuse 3 was right behind it

messages.label: FUSES 3/3
messages.text: Three fuses. Three clicks. And at the end of the hall, the EXIT sign turned green.
GO GO GO

messages.label: LOBBY · 5:59 AM
messages.text: Jay ran down the stairwell, floor after floor... and burst out into the sunrise.
i'm out. i woke up at my desk 😭
told you. i know my games 😎
jay wait. the game says *2 players* are still in the halls
The Endless Halls and eight more horror games, free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game site, so play it on a computer. Escape... if you can.
